title: Kill Beitild
description: Nazir of the Dark Brotherhood issues a contract to assassinate Beitild, the angry and desperate mine boss who runs Iron-Breaker Mine in Dawnstar and is feuding with her estranged husband Leigelf.

base_facts: I am a Redguard assassin and member of the Dark Brotherhood.
I hand out contracts to fellow Brotherhood members at the Sanctuary.
Beitild separated from her husband Leigelf and now runs Iron-Breaker Mine. She is angry, desperate, and a fighter.

CONTRACT_RECEIVED: I have given the contract to kill Beitild.
BEITILD_KILLED: The contract on Beitild has been fulfilled. I await the killer's return.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have paid the leveled gold reward for the Beitild contract; the amount scales with the player's level.
I remarked on Beitild's death with a quip about the mining business being cutthroat and the hours being murder.
The first batch of side contracts I handed out, including Beitild's, is now concluded.
I am ready to offer the next side contract from the remaining pool once the player asks.

base_facts: I run Iron-Breaker Mine in Dawnstar and keep a close eye on my workers.
I separated from my husband Leigelf months ago and we now run competing mining operations.
I despise my husband and his Quicksilver Mine.
I run Quicksilver Mine in Dawnstar.
I am feuding with my estranged wife Beitild who runs the competing Iron-Breaker Mine.

BEITILD_KILLED: My wife Beitild is dead. Can't say I miss that old sabre cat.
QUEST_COMPLETE: My wife Beitild is dead. I reacted without emotion, saying I can't say I miss that old sabre cat.
With Beitild gone, Iron-Breaker Mine in Dawnstar no longer has its angry and desperate boss.

beats.comment: Player receives the contract from Nazir to kill Beitild. Stage 10 fires.
Beitild has been killed. Stage 20 fires and the objective to report back appears.
Player reports back to Nazir and collects the leveled gold reward. Stage 200 finishes the quest.
